mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_product(tenant_id, product_key, name, cover_image_url, thumbnail_url, description, protocol_type, device_type, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productKey}, #{name}, #{coverImageUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{description}, #{protocolType}, #{deviceType}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT id, tenant_id, product_key, name, cover_image_url, thumbnail_url, description, protocol_type, device_type, status, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_product
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE iot_product SET name = #{name}, cover_image_url = #{coverImageUrl}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, description = #{description}, protocol_type = #{protocolType}, device_type = #{deviceType}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey}
UPDATE iot_product SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_key = #{productKey}
